errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена като “Цена за USD/kWh”

The labeled intervals on the y-axis are 200 USD, not 100 USD.
The description lists values for the y-axis at every 100 USD increment, but the chart only displays labels for every 200 USD (0, 200, 400, etc.).
